Enable acknowledgments when receiving from a queue.
Notice that, when this option is provided, spark acknowledges
messages from the queue, signaling to AMPS that the message has
been fully processed. (See the chapter on Message Queues in this
guide for more information.)

Request a max_backlog of greater than 1 when receiving from a
queue. (See the chapter on Message Queues in this guide for more
information.)
Publishes records to the secondary server specified.

Use delta subscription (sends a delta_subscribe command to
AMPS).

Optional format used for displaying messages. May contain literal
separator characters mixed with format tags.
Allowed tags are:
{bookmark}, {command}, {correlation_id}, {data},
{expiration}, {lease_period}, {length}, {sowkey}, {user_id},
{timestamp}, {topic}
